bagPolicy.summary: Chase Center has a strict bag policy to ensure the safety and enjoyment of all guests. Bags must be clear and no larger than 14" x 14" x 6".
allowed: Clear bags no larger than 14" x 14" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medical bags and diaper bags, which will be subject to inspection.

parking.note: Chase Center offers multiple parking options, including official lots and nearby garages. Pricing varies depending on the event and location, and it is recommended to book in advance. Public transportation and rideshare services are also encouraged due to limited parking availability.

rideshare.note: Use the official pickup and drop-off area along Terry Francois Boulevard.

concessions.note: Chase Center introduces eight new local eateries and concepts, emphasizing Bay Area flavors. Highlights include women-owned businesses from La Cocina, award-winning cheeses from Cowgirl Creamery, and unique offerings like the Hot Dog Bills Burger Dog.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available in all price categories. Free wheelchair escorts and assistive listening devices are available, but wheelchairs are not rented. Leashed or harnessed service animals are welcome. Through KultureCity, sensory bags are available at the Guest Service Kiosks near Portal 13 and Portal 52.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed at any Chase Center event. If you leave, you will not be let back in without an unused, unscanned ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office is at the West Entrance, open Monday through Friday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., and on weekends only on event days starting one hour before doors. Will call pickup is at the Box Office and requires photo ID.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: All Chase Center entrances are wheelchair accessible. For Warriors games, doors open 90 to 120 minutes before the start time. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
